## Goal
Create a fresh implementation/version of the `/add-rubrics` route work because PR #15 is now significantly outdated.

## Context
- Request came from PR #15: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/15
- PR #15 originally implemented issue #9: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/9
- The original goal was a minimal explicit route that lets a user describe rubric changes in chat, converts that into valid rubric YAML, writes to `agent/rubrics`, validates changes, and posts a concise in-thread status.
- PR #15 added route wiring, envelope/runtime support, `.github/workflows/agent-add-rubrics.yml`, `.github/prompts/agent-add-rubrics.md`, summary formatting, tests, and docs, but it has aged relative to current `main`.
- Later PR discussion raised follow-up concerns: review existing rubrics before adding new ones, prefer updating existing rubrics when appropriate, keep the public route name `/add-rubrics`, and document it as add-or-update behavior rather than renaming it to `/update-rubrics`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Reassess current `main` before porting any old PR #15 changes.
- Implement a current, minimal `/add-rubrics` route if it is still missing or incomplete.
- Preserve existing route naming unless current code/docs establish a newer convention.
- Ensure the route can add or update rubrics on `agent/rubrics` with validation and a clear user-facing summary.
- Address known robustness concerns from the old PR where still relevant: serialized direct writes, visible persistence failures, and prompt/docs consistency.
- Update tests and docs alongside behavior changes.
- Do not blindly merge or revive the old branch; use PR #15 as context for intent and prior review findings.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/15
